slice: W01/F08 portable paragraph-style recorder, packages and batch replay

semantics.styleOutputs: Separate from layer outputs; previous ensure/update IDs and aliases survive renames; missing/skipped/removed/non-style references fail
semantics.ensure: Create fresh IDs or reuse normalized name only when full formatting is identical; differing formats fail without overwrite
semantics.commands: Shared paragraph-style commands validate locks, followers, overrides, reflow and atomic undo
semantics.recorder: Dependencies and linked group template references are portable; history snapshots preserve bindings; undefined inherited setters record selective resets
semantics.batch: Existing saved recipe snapshots and per-item parameters drive independent native checkpoints and exports

verification.earlierValidation: Initial focused fixture mistakenly used a nonexistent clone method, corrected before acceptance. Restricted full test run failed local listener and source-map child-process EPERM checks; final full suite runs with local process permissions. The first browser batch fixture needed a rendering context before encoding its blank canvas; a second harness assertion was corrected to compare the authoritative saved recipe, including its storage-assigned modified timestamp. The corrected workflow runs the real batch. The production fixture also uses the recorder tab label with its live REC count. Production then reproduced a real dialog-lifetime bug that discarded the chosen recipe name/options; these preferences now live in editor-session UI state and are verified across closing/reopening. Original logs and failed browser reports retained.

limits: All editor commands are not yet recordable; unsupported commands still reject whole recordings
Existing named styles with different formatting require explicit review, not automatic overwrite
Base-only recordings against preexisting styles rely on corresponding target followers for a visible change
Template concrete typography must agree with its referenced style/overrides; no added smart-object recipe template kind
Functional suite passes do not establish sustained all-tool latency, physical device behavior, photographic/typographic quality or peak process memory
All other unfinished professional, AI/provider/evaluation/production, workflow/collaboration/commercial and specialist roadmap requirements remain active
